audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice on the whole page, and Primal Howl was never mentioned once despite being his trade-winning button.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s for a 1.5s suppress. Jaws of the Beast is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s at only 365 range and heals off your MAX health, so it punishes HP but not distance. Primal Howl is 15/14/13/12/11s and gives 2.5s of damage reduction before the 1s fear — poking into that window is throwing damage away.
audit.corrected: All three cooldowns and Primal Howl's damage-reduction window now stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull, report[5].t and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Infinite Duress' with no number; nothing said when NOT to fight.
audit.why: Primal Howl's 2.5s damage reduction is the concrete 'do not poke now' window, and his Q lunge is only 365 range so staying outside it is a hard rule, not a vibe.
Anti-heal was already in itemization and in dosFull[0].t; dontsFull[1].d body was unrelated boilerplate so it now names the three healing sources.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Warwick's Infinite Duress is down.
edits.after: His Q heals off your max HP on a 365-range lunge and his passive lifesteals harder as you drop — give CS, not HP.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Warwick must walk into your range.
edits.after: Q's resist shred stabilizes you, but extended trades still feed Eternal Hunger lifesteal — a coin-flip skirmish.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Infinite Duress's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even-to-his: your Q poke trades against his 8s Q heal, and Primal Howl cuts damage for 2.5s. Play for 6 and buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Warwick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and Divine Judgment blanks Infinite Duress — he still suppresses you for 1.5s, but gets zero damage for it.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Infinite Duress's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's plus E's missing-health hits out-DPS his Q heal — his 8s lunge only has 365 range.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Warwick carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Ranged Kayle kites a finite drain bruiser out — low-HP lifesteal is worthless when he cannot reach you at all.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — His all-in suppress. R-invuln it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: IMPORTANT UNVERIFIED CLAIM LEFT ON THE PAGE: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and the mid/late prose all say Kayle's R means Infinite Duress 'can no longer pin you'. Kayle's R grants invulnerability, not CC immunity — the suppression itself should still apply; what it blanks is the damage. I could not verify from the kits whether R prevents the suppress, so I did NOT rewrite those strings, but the new phases[4].why states the conservative version (suppressed for 1.5s, zero damage). If the user confirms R does not break the suppress, those three strings need the same correction. Packet suspect names 'Divine Judgment's' and 'Radiant Blast's' are FALSE POSITIVES — possessive forms of real abilities.
